# E7 — regenerated patch silently lost hunks after git reset

**Section**: E. CI quality
**Keywords**: diff, expected, git, grep, hunks, lost, patch, quality, re-stage, regenerated, regenerating, regeneration, reset, silently, staged, touched, touches, unstaged, verify

## Problem

regenerated patch silently lost hunks after git reset

## Root cause

git reset unstaged files; regenerated diff from only one staged file

## Solution

always re-stage ALL touched files before regenerating a patch; verify patch touches expected files (grep '^diff --git')
